name: updatePatientProfile
shortDescription: Allows patients to securely update their personal profile information, including contact details and demographic data, with validation.
description:
Overview

Enables patients to manage and update their personal profile information, such as contact details, emergency contacts, and demographic data. It includes validation to ensure data integrity and format compliance.

Intended use

Called by the patient portal UI when a patient submits changes to their profile. Also callable by administrators to update patient profiles.

Logic

  1. Retrieve the existing PatientProfile record for the authenticated user using ctx.data.get.
  2. Validate the incoming params against business rules (e.g., date formats, required fields, email uniqueness if changed). Return an error if validation fails.
  3. Update the PatientProfile record with the provided data using ctx.data.update.
  4. Audit-log the profile update using ctx.audit.log.
  5. Return the updated PatientProfile.

Entities

  • PatientProfile
